title: Vishwanath and Sons
synopsis: Sanjay Vishwanath has devoted decades to excellence as an international shooter. When age, family duties, and an unexpected romance collide with his ambitions, he must confront what truly makes a life worth living.

synopsis_lang.en: Sanjay Vishwanath has devoted decades to excellence as an international shooter. When age, family duties, and an unexpected romance collide with his ambitions, he must confront what truly makes a life worth living.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: Sanjay Vishwanath 身為國際射擊選手，數十年來全心投入、追求卓越。當年齡、家庭責任，以及一段意料之外的戀情，與他的雄心壯志相互衝撞時，他必須正視一個問題——究竟什麼才讓人生真正值得活。
